findings.reason: The Barrier only aligns thread start; the client's check-then-set critical section is a few bytecodes, so a lock-free lost-update implementation would almost always still produce exactly one winner under CPython's default 5ms switch interval. The test can therefore pass a regression that removes AmapClient.bind_runtime's lock, so it proves the outcome of this run rather than mutual exclusion.
findings.recommendation: Add a deterministic interleaving test (hold client._lock to order the two attempts, or lower sys.setswitchinterval and repeat the race) so removing the lock makes the test fail; keep the current one-winner assertion.

findings.quote: 模拟的发送次数与真实适配器同一口径（origin 1 / poi 1 / weather 1 /
findings.reason: The real adapter sends one detail request per resolved non-origin POI (3 for the three-candidate fixture), so the real normal run is 15; the fake models hours as 2 and yields 13. The delta is +2 (weather adcode plus hours), not only the weather adcode as impl-reports/task1-http-admission.md §4 line 74 states (13 + 1 is not 15). The fake is a simplification; the claim misstates the model and can mislead future test authors.
findings.recommendation: Correct the docstring and report arithmetic, and either make FakeAdapter.hours send one request per resolved candidate or explicitly label the fake count as a simplified model.
